description: Auto-save/load context on session lifecycle events

hooks.command: [ "$TIMELINER_AUTO_COMPACT" != "false" ] && TIMELINER_HOOK_RUNNING=1 claude -p --no-session-persistence --resume "$(cat | jq -r '.session_id')" "/tliner:save. Answer with `task_id` only" || true

since=$(date -u -d '5 minutes ago' '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'); ctx=$(uvx tliner get-steps --since "$since" 2>/dev/null || echo 'No recent context'); jq -n --arg ctx "$ctx" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:$ctx}}'
